data.title: UNITE HERE Local 8: Are Hilton Hotels nICE Hotels? Seattle Embassy Suites Workers Call Out Company’s Insufficient Protections for Immigrants as Strike Passes 50 Days
data.description: In Seattle, workers at the Embassy Suites by Hilton Seattle Downtown Pioneer Square are on a 50-day strike, organized by their union UNITE HERE Local 8. The union is criticizing Hilton Hotels for refusing to agree to contract language that would mandate the company to notify Local 8 about the presence of ICE or DHS agents at the hotel. As a form of protest, the union has set up a digital billboard in downtown Seattle and targeted Hilton customers with digital ads featuring Hilton's logo inside an ice cube, highlighting the company's stance on the issue.
